en: Next up, attacking![p]By the way, lots of right-arm Devices can do rapid-fire attacks,[p]while left-arm Devices include ones for close-range attacks, Shields that block attacks, and all sorts of other things.[p]Right-arm attacks use the A Button, and left-arm attacks use the B Button.[p]Now go ahead and try attacking for real![close]

en: By the way, your Dino's health meters are at the bottom of the screen. The one on the left is for your Dino,[p]and the one on the right is for your opponent's Dino. The Battery you charged earlier is shown next to the health meter.[p]If it runs out, you lose even if you still have health left, so be careful![p]Now, take a look at the top of the screen. You should see gauges stretching out on the right and left.[p]If you attack while a gauge is long, you'll do more damage.[p]The left gauge is for your left arm, and the right gauge is for your right arm.[p]

en: There are 5 kinds of Bursts, and each one has a different power, so try out lots of them.[p]When the gauge at the top fills all the way up, you can use a Bolt-On.[p]When it's full, if an L or R mark appears next to your Dino, press that button.[p]The L Button does a left-arm Bolt-On, and the R Button does a right-arm Bolt-On. Then just press the attack button for the Bolted-On arm and you're all set![close]

en: Also, you only have 1 Dino this time, so it doesn't matter yet, but when you have 3, you can switch Dinos with the SELECT Button.[p]Different Devices have all kinds of attacks, so collect them and try them out yourself.[p]Finally, Dinos have elements. There are 5 kinds: Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth and Special. Fire is strong against Water, Water is strong against Thunder, Thunder is strong against Earth, and Earth is strong against Fire. Special has the same effect against every element. Remember that, okay?[E0 20 00 57][close]

en: Oh, that reminds me, I never showed you how to equip Devices before a battle. First, choose where to make your Entry. The spot where the cursor is now should be fine, so try pressing the A Button here.[close]

en: Then a list of the Dinos you can enter will appear at the bottom of the screen. Right now you only have 1 Dino, so that's the only one you can choose.[p]Press the A Button to enter it.[close]

en: There! You've set a Device on your Dino.[p]To stop setting Devices, press the B Button and move the cursor all the way down.[p]Then press the A Button to finish.[p]Okay, go ahead and try out all sorts of things.[close]

en: We're back at the Dino Entry screen.[p]You only have 1 Dino right now, so that's it.[p]Move the cursor to the spot glowing green and press the A Button to finish your Entry.[close]

When you're done charging, move the cursor to the spot glowing green and press the A Button.[close]

en: That's it for the Battery Charge.[p]In battle, your Dino fights with the energy you charged. If the charge drops to 0, that Dino can't battle anymore, so be careful.[p]Also, in some battles you'll need Entries for the other 2 Dinos too.[p]Anyway, you only have 1 this time, so that's all for now.[p]Okay, next I'll explain battles![close]
